defaultDescription: Three controls. One creative decision. A free, offline-capable exposure triangle simulator that teaches aperture, shutter speed and ISO through hands-on experiment.

routes.title: Tatu Exposure Lab by Storitellah — Learn the Exposure Triangle
routes.description: Three controls. One creative decision. A free interactive exposure triangle simulator for young photographers, students and teachers. Works offline, no account needed.

routes.title: Learn Photography Exposure — 12 Guided Lessons | Tatu Exposure Lab
routes.description: Twelve guided lessons that teach exposure step by step: aperture and depth of field, shutter speed and motion, ISO and noise, stops of light, metering and histograms.

routes.title: Free Camera Simulator — Aperture, Shutter Speed and ISO | Tatu Exposure Lab
routes.description: Practise manual mode in a realistic camera simulator. Change aperture, shutter speed and ISO and see depth of field, motion blur and noise change instantly.

routes.title: Video Exposure and Shutter Angle Simulator | Tatu Exposure Lab
routes.description: Learn frame rate, shutter angle and the 180-degree rule. Compare 24, 25, 30, 50, 60 and 120 fps and see how shutter speed changes motion cadence.

routes.title: Photography Challenges — Freeze Motion, Blur Backgrounds | Tatu Exposure Lab
routes.description: Practical photography challenges: freeze a footballer, create light trails, blur a portrait background, keep a landscape sharp, shoot clean in low light.

routes.title: Your Shot Gallery | Tatu Exposure Lab
routes.description: Your simulated photographs, stored privately on your own device. Compare attempts, mark favourites, export and print. Nothing is ever uploaded.

routes.title: Print Studio — Worksheets, Contact Sheets and Certificates | Tatu Exposure Lab
routes.description: Print photographs with their camera settings, contact sheets, exposure triangle worksheets and challenge certificates in A4, US Letter and photo sizes.

routes.title: Teacher Mode — Classroom Photography Lessons | Tatu Exposure Lab
routes.description: Build classroom photography lessons with no student accounts: lock controls, share a challenge link or QR code, print worksheets and export an answer guide.

routes.title: Photography Glossary — Stops, Depth of Field, Shutter Angle | Tatu Exposure Lab
routes.description: Plain-language and advanced definitions of stops of light, depth of field, motion blur, ISO noise, dynamic range, crop factor, histograms, T-stops and log video.

routes.title: Use My Camera — Optional Live Exposure Preview | Tatu Exposure Lab
routes.description: An optional mode that shows a simulated exposure preview over your own camera image. Permission is only requested when you press the button; nothing is uploaded.

routes.title: Accessibility Statement | Tatu Exposure Lab
routes.description: How Tatu Exposure Lab meets WCAG 2.2 AA: keyboard operation, screen-reader labels, high-contrast and large-control modes, reduced motion and colour-safe indicators.

routes.title: Privacy — No Accounts, No Uploads, No Tracking | Tatu Exposure Lab
routes.description: Your photographs and progress never leave your device. No accounts, no uploads, no trackers, no location, no microphone. Delete everything with one tap.

routes.title: Security | Tatu Exposure Lab
routes.description: Security assumptions, data flow, camera permissions, upload validation, export handling and security headers for Tatu Exposure Lab, plus how to report a vulnerability.

routes.title: About Tatu Exposure Lab by Storitellah
routes.description: Tatu means three. Photography exposure is controlled by three connected settings: aperture, shutter speed and ISO. An independent educational tool by Storitellah.

routes.title: Support and Bug Reports | Tatu Exposure Lab
routes.description: Answers to common questions about exposure, camera permission, offline use, saved photographs and printing — plus how to report a bug.
